name: notification-tones
description: Distinct musical tones for each reason Claude Code stops, so you can tell from another room whether it finished, needs permission, or is waiting on an answer.

only_when_unfocused.title: Only play when the terminal is not focused
only_when_unfocused.description: Stay silent while you are looking at the terminal, since you can already see what happened. Set false to always play. When focus cannot be determined the tone plays anyway.

task_complete_tone.title: Play a tone when a task completes
task_complete_tone.description: The completion tone fires at the end of every turn, including short answers. Turn this off to keep only the permission and question tones.

question_style.title: Question tone voicing
question_style.description: ascending-pause (E5, pause, G#5) or descending (G#5 to E5). Both signal 'your turn'; pick whichever reads that way to your ear.
